license.notes: Author page states CC0/public domain and no attribution required. Keep source metadata with the profile even when attribution is optional.

asset.install_note: Open the download page, choose 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads', download WRAD_ARMS.zip, then rerun IMPORT_FPE_HAND_ASSET.ps1. The importer extracts the GLB and copies/renames it to wrad_arms.glb at the stable scene_path.

retarget.notes: Populate after INSPECT_FPE_HAND_ASSET.ps1 reports the imported GLB mesh paths and named Skin binds.
